recentItems.title: Hampton kicks off Van Malone era with shutout win
recentItems.description: Van Malone has been in college coaching for more than two decades as an assistant, but checked another box Saturday night.  Hampton's 45-0 win over Virginia University of Lynchburg gave Malone his first victory as a college head coach in the Pirates' season opener.

recentItems.title: Norfolk State opens with convincing shutout victory over Winston-Salem State
recentItems.description: It was a small sample size and against a Division II opponent, but Norfolk State looked better Saturday night than it did at any point during the 2025 season.  Deljay Bailey threw for three touchdowns and rushed for an additional score, leading the Spartans past Winston-Salem State, 56-0. It marked the program's first shutout since 2019 and the first time the green and gold have eclipsed 50 points since 2021.

recentItems.title: Portsmouth's Bloom Market launches incubator program to help small businesses find a permanent home
recentItems.description: Bloom Coworking is transforming its market in downtown Portsmouth into a retail incubator, splitting the space into four subsidized retail locations for small business owners. The program, developed in partnership with Portsmouth's Main Street Initiative and the Small Business Development Center, gives entrepreneurs a two-year window to grow their businesses, receive mentorship, and transition into permanent storefronts in the Olde Towne district. Applications are open at bloommarket.org.

recentItems.description: 🏈 College football season is here! Hampton University's Van Malone makes his head coaching debut tonight while Norfolk State's Michael Vick era rolls into year two.  Catch the full recap on WTKR News 3 tonight and WTKR.com. 🏈
